title: Identification, estimation, and robust inference of structural autoregressions for multidimensional data
abstract: arXiv:2611.13169v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many modern datasets such as cross-country panels have a multidimensional structure. Conventional approaches on structural vector autoregressions for identifying structural shocks are not directly suited to these settings where data are naturally organized as matrices or tensors, since the number of parameters grows rapidly and identifying restrictions become hard to impose. We introduce a class of structural autoregressions for multidimensional data that achieves tractability and global identification by assuming a Kronecker structure on the model coefficients. We develop a minimum-distance estimator and establish its asymptotic distribution. To accommodate approximate Kronecker separability, we develop confidence intervals for the structural impulse response functions that are robust to local misspecification, and we show their asymptotic validity. translated_title: 面向多维数据的结构自回归模型的识别、估计与稳健推断
translated_abstract: 许多现代数据集（如跨国面板数据）具有多维结构。传统的结构向量自回归方法虽然用于识别结构性冲击，但并不直接适用于这类数据天然以矩阵或张量形式组织的场景，因为参数数量会迅速增长，且识别性约束难以施加。我们提出了一类适用于多维数据的结构自回归模型，通过假设模型系数具有Kronecker（克罗内克）结构，实现了模型的可处理性与全局识别。我们开发了一种最小距离估计量，并建立了其渐近分布。为容纳近似Kronecker可分性的情形，我们为结构脉冲响应函数构建了对局部模型误设稳健的置信区间，并证明了其渐近有效性。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了渐近近似的有效性。
tldr: 本文针对矩阵或张量形式的多维数据提出一类具有Kronecker系数结构的结构自回归模型，实现了全局识别与可处理估计，并开发了最小距离估计量及对局部模型误设稳健的脉冲响应置信区间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes structural autoregressions for multidimensional (matrix/tensor) data with Kronecker-structured coefficients, achieving global identification and tractable estimation via a minimum-distance estimator, along with impulse response confidence intervals that are robust to local misspecification.
